hook.cap: A ₹28,000 crore Tata deal is under fire. And the Tata family fight has reached court.
head: TATA UNDER
THE LENS

stories.headline: Tata Steel deal draws questions
stories.cap: Proxy advisers want SEBI to look closely at the ₹28,000 crore Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. APL Apollo would buy two Tata Steel businesses, paid for with debt. Tata Steel would also buy the promoters' stake for ₹15,510 crore. APL Apollo shares have fallen more than 30% since the deal was announced.

head: IS THE DEAL
FAIR?
beats.note: Advisers say the *linked parts* of the deal should be *judged together.*

head: APL BUYS
TATA UNITS
beats.note: The purchase is *funded with debt,* which public shareholders of APL Apollo will *carry.*

head: TATA BUYS
PROMOTERS' STAKE
beats.note: Tata Steel gets *control* of the tubes maker by buying out the *promoters.*

head: SHARES
DOWN 30%+
beats.note: Tata Steel says it is *examining the concerns* raised by investors.

sources.title: Sebi may scrutinise Tata Steel-APL Apollo deal over RPT, shareholder worry
Proxy advisors flag related-party concerns in Tata Steel-APL Apollo transaction

summary.line: Proxy advisers want SEBI to examine the ₹28,000 crore Tata Steel–APL Apollo deal; APL Apollo shares are down over 30% since it was announced.

stories.headline: Tata Trusts move High Court
stories.cap: Tata Trusts have gone to the Bombay High Court. They challenge the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman. The court hears the case on Friday, before the Tata Sons board meeting on 30 November. The trusts also seek damages of ₹50 crore and ₹15 crore.

head: TATA VS
TATA?
beats.note: The trusts say the *September 17 vote* did not get the *required support.*

head: HEARING
ON FRIDAY
beats.note: The trusts want *no casting vote* by the chairman at the *30 November* board meeting.

head: DAMAGES
SOUGHT
beats.note: Two trusts ask for *₹50 crore* and *₹15 crore,* plus 18% yearly interest.

sources.title: HC to hear Tata Trusts' plea against Chandra's reappointment on Friday
Bombay HC to hear Tata Trusts' lawsuits against Chandrasekaran's reappointment on Friday ahead of Nov 30 board meeting

summary.line: Tata Trusts have sued in the Bombay High Court over Chandrasekaran's reappointment; hearing is Friday, ahead of the 30 November board meeting.

stories.headline: Markets rise, cautious start
stories.cap: Indian markets rose for a second day on Thursday. The Sensex gained 390 points and the Nifty gained 65 points. Analysts expect a cautious start today, after a strong rally.

head: MARKETS UP
TWO DAYS
beats.note: Both indices *extended their gains* for a *second straight day.*

head: CAUTIOUS
OPENING?
beats.note: After a *strong rally,* analysts see *profit taking* and sideways moves.

sources.title: Top stocks to watch today: NSE, Tata Group, Texmaco Rail, Tata Motors shares in focus on Friday, 27 November
Gift Nifty indicates a cautious opening for Indian stocks

summary.line: Sensex added 390 points and Nifty 65 points on Thursday; analysts expect a cautious opening today.

stories.headline: NSE gets RBI nod for bond futures
stories.cap: The RBI has cleared the National Stock Exchange to bring in a new product. These are futures that track corporate bond indices.

head: BOND FUTURES
GET RBI NOD
beats.note: The *RBI approval* covers futures tied to *corporate bond indices.*

sources.title: Top stocks to watch today: NSE, Tata Group, Texmaco Rail, Tata Motors shares in focus on Friday, 27 November
Stocks in focus, Nov 27: TVS group companies, NSE, Unimech, Omnitech, Texmaco Rail, Apeejay, EMS, Waaree Renewable, Bansal Wire, Zydus among the others

summary.line: RBI has cleared NSE to bring in futures that track corporate bond indices.

stories.headline: Nvidia pauses Asia shipments
stories.cap: Nvidia has asked partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. Dell and Supermicro told buyers their orders will not be sent. This follows new US export curbs on advanced AI chips. It is unclear if the pause is temporary.

head: NVIDIA HITS
PAUSE
beats.note: Shipments of *servers with its chips* to *four countries* are on hold.

head: ORDERS
NOT SENT
beats.note: These firms *package the chips* into servers and *told buyers* the orders will not ship.

head: NEW US
EXPORT CURBS
beats.note: Washington wants to shut *routes* Chinese firms may use to get *advanced AI chips.*

head: TEMPORARY
OR NOT?
beats.note: Reports say it is *not clear* how long the *halt* will last.

sources.title: Nvidia halts shipments of AI servers to four Southeast Asian countries
NVIDIA reportedly halts AI chip shipments to Southeast Asia
Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia

summary.line: Nvidia has asked partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new US export curbs.
